goal: The incremental ingest (extend) has tests that kill baseline's surviving mutations D and E.
why: BD-269: two baseline mutations survived. D: each run is evaluated at the phase's last time instead of its own. E: the fallback for a vanished record is turned off. Both are test gaps, not wrong results.

scope.text: A test where two runs differ in their own evaluation time so that evaluating both at the phase's last time changes a value (mutation D). If no input under the default config can show a difference, say so with the probe and use a config where it can.
A test where a record vanishes between extends and the fallback path must produce the full-rebuild result (mutation E).

done_when.text: Mutations D and E (as described in BD-269) are each killed by a named test; incremental == full rebuild still holds on the existing property test.
Suite green in a fresh clone with sibling repos; report as report/2 in English on #3 with the commit sha.
